description: Upload a file to attach to a DM (send_dm file_ids). Give text for a text file, or content_base64 for any other file (max 5 MB). Returns its file_id. Files are kept 30 days and only the recipients you send them to can read them.

mime_type.description: e.g. text/markdown, image/png; guessed from the name if omitted

name: upload_file
